correctness.rationale: Independent geometric CDFs give an exact three-exponential mass formula. The pairwise exponential-sum Turan identity gives Delta_k=(rs)^(k-1)H(k), with H(1)=rs(1-r)^2(1-s)^2(r+s+2)>0, H strictly decreasing, and limit H=-(1-r)(1-s)(r-s)^2. Hence one unique real transition for unequal rates and a strictly positive all-k formula for equal rates. On three-point support, log-concavity reduces to v<=u^2,z<=w^2 and implies c1^2-c0c2>=uw(u+w+2)>0. The four-point example yields exactly -3/50000 before positive normalization. Symbolic and rational checker succeeded; finite checks do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The exact single curvature-reversal classification demonstrates that iid order-statistic log-concavity preservation is structurally sharp for geometric tails: every unequal pair loses LC eventually and at exactly one transition, while equal pairs preserve it globally. The rigorous three-point universal theorem and four-point rational counterexample establish a natural minimal support threshold for independent LC inputs. These quantitative boundaries are useful when applying unimodality and distribution-shape closure methods to heterogeneous counts, and exceed a routine single numerical counterexample.
